items.raw_excerpt: The government is moving ahead with its plans to cap the amount councils can increase rates by to a maximum of 4 percent, but won't be able to pass the legislation until next term.
items.summary_en: The government plans to limit how much local councils can increase rates each year. Under the new rule, councils would not be able to raise rates by more than 4 percent. The legislation will not be ready until the next government term.
items.summary_ko: 정부는 지방자치단체가 부과하는 지방세의 연간 인상폭을 4%로 제한하는 방안을 추진하고 있습니다. 이 규정은 다음 정부 임기까지는 시행되지 않을 전망입니다.
items.title_en: Rates rises to be capped at 4 percent
items.title_original: Rates rises to be capped at 4 percent

items.raw_excerpt: A Saskatchewan village is celebrating its history with a new museum, three years after the project began. Fruzsina De Cloedt has the story.
items.summary_en: A small village in Saskatchewan is celebrating its history with a new museum. The project began three years ago. The museum shows the village's story and heritage.
items.summary_ko: 서스캐처원의 작은 마을이 역사를 기념하기 위해 새 박물관을 열었습니다. 이 프로젝트는 3년 전에 시작됐습니다. 박물관은 마을의 이야기와 유산을 보여줍니다.
items.title_en: New museum opens in Stockholm, Saskatchewan
items.title_original: New museum in Stockholm, Sask. celebrates village history - CTV News

items.raw_excerpt: I was only 16 when told I would never be able to carry a child. Ten years later, there was some hope.
items.summary_en: A woman was told at age 16 that she would never be able to carry a child. It was too hard for a teenager to understand such news. Ten years later, she found some hope.
items.summary_ko: 한 여성은 열여섯 살에 아이를 가질 수 없다는 말을 들었습니다. 너무 어린 나이여서 그 말을 제대로 이해하기 힘들었습니다. 10년이 지난 뒤 조금씩 희망이 보였습니다.
items.title_en: Told at 16 she could not have a child, she found hope at 26
items.title_ko: 16살에 아이를 가질 수 없다는 진단, 10년 뒤 찾아온 희망
items.title_original: I was too young to understand infertility when diagnosed at 16

items.raw_excerpt: LPG users gain relief as eKYC deadline extended to August 31, allowing more time to complete mandatory authentication.
items.summary_en: People who use cooking gas in Hyderabad get more time for mandatory authentication. The eKYC deadline is extended to August 31. This gives them relief from a paperwork rush.
items.summary_ko: 하이데라바드에서 취사용 가스를 쓰는 사람들이 필수 인증을 할 시간을 더 얻었습니다. 전자 본인 인증(eKYC) 마감일이 8월 31일로 연장됐습니다. 덕분에 서류 절차를 서두르는 부담이 줄었습니다.
items.title_original: Breather for LPG users as eKYC deadline extended to August 31

items.raw_excerpt: Running from Sep 3 to 6, Another Coffee Festival brings together specialty coffee roasters from Asia and Europe. Organised by Morning's Leon Foo and Alchemist's Will Leow, the event is open to all and celebrates coffee as a cultural, creative and social experience.
items.summary_en: Another Coffee Festival runs from Sep 3 to 6 in Tanjong Pagar. It brings 34 specialty coffee roasters from Asia and Europe together. The event is open to everyone and celebrates coffee as culture, creativity and social life.
items.summary_ko: 탄종파가르에서 9월 3일부터 6일까지 또 하나의 커피 축제가 열립니다. 아시아와 유럽의 스페셜티 커피 로스터 34곳이 모입니다. 누구나 참여할 수 있으며 커피를 문화와 창의, 사람을 잇는 경험으로 기념하는 행사입니다.
items.title_en: Coffee festival in Tanjong Pagar brings together 34 roasters
items.title_ko: 탄종파가르 커피 축제, 세계 34개 로스터 한자리에
items.title_original: A 4-day coffee festival in Tanjong Pagar will bring together 34 roasters from around the world

items.raw_excerpt: The Rabbitohs successfully petition the NRL to change the league's interchange rules to allow Jai Arrow to take the field for his 99th and 100th games for South Sydney in the last two rounds of the year.
items.summary_en: A rugby player is one game away from his 100th game for his club. The league changed its rules so he can play those final games. It is a small, personal milestone for a local team.
items.summary_ko: 한 럭비 선수가 소속팀에서 100번째 경기를 한 경기 앞두고 있다. 리그가 그가 마지막 경기들에서 뛸 수 있도록 규칙을 바꿨다. 지역 팀의 개인적인 작은 이정표다.
items.title_en: League changes rules so player can reach 100th game
items.title_ko: 선수 100번째 경기 위해 리그 규칙 바뀌어
items.title_original: NRL changes rules to allow Jai Arrow to 'play' 100 games for Souths
